objectives: 教授2G至6G次世代前瞻無線通訊網路與傳輸技術之架構框架、無線通道模組、多工存取技術、通訊協定層、多天線、毫米波頻譜及其應用以及AI相關通訊技術，並瞭解當下潛在之國際發展趨勢，瞭解且研究未來潛在通訊系統、訊號處理或通訊網路及AI應用於通訊之發展。
content:
1	Introduction to 2G-6G
2	Cellular Networks
3	Wireless Protocols
4	Wireless Protocols
5	Transmission Frame Structures
6	Division, Multiplexing, Multiple Access
7	Handover Mechanisms
8	Channel Models and Network Performances
9	Midterm
10	Numerologies
11	Millimeter Wave
12	MIMO Beamforming
13	AI for Communications
14	Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC)
15	Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS)
16	Final Report Presentation
